senses.sense_definition: The absence of belief in the existence of deities, or the positive belief that no deities exist.

examples.text: His philosophical journey led him from devout faith to outspoken <w>atheism</w>.

target_lang_translations.zh: 他的哲学探索之旅使他从虔诚的信仰转向了公开的<w>无神论</w>。

examples.text: The debate centered on whether modern <w>atheism</w> is merely a lack of belief or an active worldview.

target_lang_translations.zh: 辩论的焦点在于现代<w>无神论</w>究竟只是缺乏信仰，还是一种积极的世界观。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 不相信神灵存在，或明确认为神灵不存在的观念或学说。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 否定神灵存在的基本思想或信仰立场

senses.sense_definition: The rejection of all religions, including non-theistic spiritual systems and doctrines.

examples.text: The regime promoted scientific <w>atheism</w> and systematically suppressed both traditional churches and Buddhist temples.

target_lang_translations.zh: 该政权宣扬科学<w>无神论</w>，并系统性地打压传统教会与佛教寺庙。

examples.text: Her strict form of <w>atheism</w> dismissed all spiritual traditions as unscientific nonsense.

target_lang_translations.zh: 她那严格的<w>无神论</w>立场将所有精神传统都斥为不科学的无稽之谈。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 对所有宗教信仰及非有神论精神学说的排斥与否定。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 排斥一切宗教和精神传统的立场

senses.sense_definition: The refusal to worship or believe in the traditional gods of a specific society or state.

examples.text: Early Christians in Rome were often executed for <w>atheism</w> because they refused to venerate imperial gods.

target_lang_translations.zh: 罗马早期的基督徒常因拒绝崇拜帝国神祇而被控犯有<w>不敬神罪</w>并处决。

examples.text: Socrates was accused of impiety and <w>atheism</w> for neglecting the recognized deities of Athens.

target_lang_translations.zh: 苏格拉底因忽视雅典城邦公认的神祇而被指控亵渎神明和信奉<w>无神论</w>。

traits.comment: Historical usage describing nonconformity to state or civic religion.

target_lang_definitions.zh: （历史用法）拒绝崇拜或不信仰特定社会或城邦所认可的传统神祇。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 特指古代因不信奉城邦传统神祇而获罪的行为
指拒不信奉国家或城邦神祇的主张
